observation.command: cd /workspace && curl -s "http://openculturas.ddev.site/en/search?keys=OpenCulturas" -o /tmp/s.html; grep -oiE "search-result|views-row|no results|result[^<]{0,40}|search_api" /tmp/s.html | sort | uniq -c | head; echo "=== search view config ==="; ls config/sync/views.view.*search* 2>/dev/null; grep -n "path:\|search_api\|index" config/sync/views.view.search*.yml 2>/dev/null | head
